actionList.name: SpeakNatural
actionList.description: Natural gesture with hand and arm movements while speaking (default for speaking)

actionList.name: PointToScreen
actionList.description: Pointing finger energetically toward the user (screen) as if saying "It's you!"

actionList.name: Nod
actionList.description: Nodding head in agreement - use when affirming or agreeing with something

actionList.name: ShakeHead
actionList.description: Shaking head side to side as if saying "No no!" - use when denying or disagreeing with something

actionList.name: ThumbsUp
actionList.description: Giving a thumbs up toward the screen as if saying "Great!"

actionList.name: FistUp
actionList.description: Raising fist up in the air with joy and excitement

actionList.name: PeaceSign
actionList.description: Making a V-sign with one hand in an excited manner

actionList.name: HandToMouth
actionList.description: Covering mouth slightly in surprise while exclaiming

actionList.name: SlumpShoulders
actionList.description: Slumping shoulders and hanging head down in disappointment

actionList.name: Sigh
actionList.description: Letting out a big sigh while shaking head in frustration

actionList.name: HighFive
actionList.description: Energetically giving a high-five toward the screen (user)

actionList.name: WaveArm
actionList.description: Waving one arm widely and energetically for greeting

actionList.name: WaveBothHands
actionList.description: Waving both hands cheerfully in greeting

actionList.name: TurnAround
actionList.description: Turning around to show the back view, then returning to original pose - use when showing off or displaying outfit details

actionList.name: ArmUp
actionList.description: Naturally raising one hand above head, then lowering it

actionList.name: LegUp
actionList.description: Kicking one leg up as if doing a leg raise, then lowering it
